verdict.rationale: Jira's feature docs describe templates for agile sprints, burndown charts and capacity management, boards for tracking progress, and breaking work into prioritized tasks. Together these cover the core of sprint planning and management. One community user complains it is hard to see which tickets were in a closed sprint, which is a usability caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on sprint creation, backlog grooming and sprint start/complete flows, and independent hands-on corroboration of the sprint workflow beyond marketing-level claims.
